A veterinary clinic with a big heart ❤️

I am incredibly grateful to Dierenkliniek Amsterdam Noord.
When I had to have my sweet Chihuahua put to sleep, they guided me with so much care, understanding, and compassion. They really took the time, showed genuine involvement, and made a very sad moment just a little softer.

They also helped me wonderfully with my new dog — he suffered from allergies, and thanks to their expert and patient approach, he is doing much better now. What I also really appreciate is that they charge fair, reasonable prices and are not commercially minded. You can just tell that they are truly there for the animals, and not for profit.

A warm, reliable, and loving team. I would recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinarian with knowledge, heart, and genuine care for every animal. ❤️🐾
Customer for years, very friendly
Highly skilled veterinarians with a passion for their work.
I have been going to these vets since Dr. Christenhuis started working there, now vet Ms. Wheel; they are such a gem! So good and understanding towards our cat squad.

Caring and also listen to the owners. They really treat the animals with love.
This is a great team!
Friendly doctor and lovely assistants
The doctor and assistants are so sweet to our dog Gerald.

We went yesterday with our rabbit. She had sticky poop on her bottom, which unfortunately had maggots in it. She also had it in her skin. They cleaned and shaved her with all the love and patience. They reassured us and were incredibly sweet. They spent about an hour and a half plucking her with tweezers, giving her a bath, etc. We were given antibiotics and painkillers, and the bill was €72. She's already on the mend. I know many people think vet bills are exorbitant, but seeing what they did for my rabbit, I personally think it's incredibly reasonable. They're more than worth the money, they're fantastic!
The veterinarians are skilled and friendly, and take the time for your pet.

Not just a veterinary clinic, but a team that truly cares about my pet. I'm incredibly grateful for the wonderful care and support.

We had to take our sick dog Luna to a vet and had asked if we could go to Dierenkliniek Amsterdam Noord because our previous vet had stopped. We went there and there was a very sweet vet (female)

Who had looked for the best solution for as long as possible, because Luna didn't have much time left; she was well over 15 and had cancer
We indicated that we didn't want the dog to suffer, and she wasn't suffering yet, but we were looking for the best solution for as long as possible; the vet had prescribed a medication to make the dog feel good
But eventually, after a month and a half, the cancer took over and we saw Luna deteriorate quickly
We called the vet and made an appointment to have Luna put to sleep at their facility
We already had a vision beforehand that we, as a family of 5 and our other dog, could take ten minutes to say goodbye before the euthanasia
This was no problem at all and they were very compassionate and this vet (male) radiated so much calm and respect towards our family so compassionate respect for that grateful 🙏
After the euthanasia, we left Luna behind and they arranged for Luna to be properly transferred to the pet crematorium
And now, a week later, we received a very sweet card With lots of strength, big hugs, and a paw print
Wow
We are very impressed by how you helped us, and thank you very much for this on behalf of our whole family🙏
Kind regards
Johan and Nancy and the children

Kind and helpful veterinarian!

I recently visited this clinic and had a very disappointing experience. When I arrived, the receptionist was very friendly and chatty with the Dutch woman in front of me; however, as soon as she heard me speak English, her attitude changed completely.

I asked to register my cat in this clinic as we just moved to the area but she bluntly told me there was a “patient stop” without offering any information on when there might be availability. Despite being registered with the same clinic chain in Westerpark, she claimed she couldn’t find our cat’s file after searching in the system (she didn’t accept looking at the papers I had with me as a proof) and then remarked that this clinic was not part of the Westerpark chain. This was confusing — why would she search for the file if the clinics are not linked or related?

Her response to my questions were curt and unhelpful, and I felt unwelcome and discriminated against. While I can’t confirm if it was intentional, the difference in treatment was stark and upsetting.

I am deeply saddened and shocked by the lack of empathy and customer service I experienced at Dierenkliniek Amsterdam Noord. My cat recently lost a tooth, and I came in seeking urgent help. The waiting room was empty, yet the receptionist informed me they weren’t taking any more patients. When I politely asked if they could make an exception given the circumstances, I was met with a cold, dismissive response and outright refusal to help.

It was incredibly disheartening to encounter such a lack of compassion in what should be a place of care and understanding for animals and their owners. I understand policies and capacity limitations, but a little empathy and kindness go a long way in moments of distress. This experience has left me questioning the values of this clinic, and I hope they consider improving their approach to customer care in the future.
